**Winner:** *Adele – “25”*  

During the **59th Annual Grammy Awards**, presented on January 27 2017, Adele received the coveted *Album of the Year* honor for her studio effort **“25.”**  
(There isn’t a distinct “Best Album” category—*Album of the Year* serves as the top prize for full‑length recordings.)
